selection_policy: Directly relevant online/open-set/uncertainty/robustness alarm-flood methods found in the three literature-expansion rounds; status is evidence-backed, not inferred from publication date.

status_semantics.verified: Official or author-equivalent implementation reproduces a representative paper result on the same dataset and protocol within declared tolerance.
status_semantics.partial: A callable independent implementation and synthetic invariants exist, but official artifact/data/table closure is incomplete.
status_semantics.missing: The paper is registered as a frontier target but no faithful callable implementation exists yet.

algorithms.name: CASIM MultiRocket-ridge-LoOP open-set AFC
algorithms.validation_evidence: E2; grouped TEP/NPP/FCC three-seed classification and five-regime robustness in experiments/reports/sota_wave2_multidataset_validation.json
algorithms.closure_gate: Official capsule/data/environment acquired; unchanged capsule-default mean BA is 0.993819 and all 700 open-set model fits are complete. Aggregate peak BA 0.955520 is within 0.02 of the paper, but threshold 0.335 vs 0.324 and full-threshold mean 0.903267 vs 0.879 remain open; P3 also requires author confirmation of the reconstructed outer loop, Figure 14b-c ablations, and Docker execution

algorithms.name: ConE-AFC class- and stepwise conformal prediction
algorithms.validation_evidence: P2 author-code paper grid on the official 18,750-sequence data: all 250 split-model tasks and 95/95 Tables I-II means closed within 0.02; E2 grouped TEP/NPP/FCC transfer remains separate
algorithms.closure_gate: P3 still requires the archived Docker-image run and an independent local-implementation comparison on the identical 50 folds

algorithms.name: Random-forest jackknife+ bifurcation forecasting
algorithms.validation_evidence: P2 official-v3 paper grid plus overlap/disjoint and seeded controls: 160 fold tasks complete; paper rows pass 6/16 author, 7/16 disjoint, 7/16 seeded-author, and 8/16 seeded-disjoint; E2 TEP/NPP/FCC transfer remains separate
algorithms.closure_gate: Resolve paper-versus-v3 numeric gaps, explicitly seed the Numba MultiRocket RNG for CASIM, verify Docker file-order/data parity, and run the independent implementation on identical folds

algorithms.name: Alarm-data-quality robustness analysis
algorithms.validation_evidence: E2; five corruption families, two severities, three prefixes, six classifiers, three real datasets, and three outer seeds
algorithms.closure_gate: ETFA full text and original experiment data

algorithms.name: AFC-RobustBench prefix/severity/mixed-corruption protocol
algorithms.validation_evidence: E2; bounded real-data prefix/severity/mixed-corruption screen with normalized robustness AUC
algorithms.closure_gate: SSRN PDF download endpoint and two process-industry datasets

algorithms.name: Data-efficient cross-conformal online AFC
algorithms.validation_evidence: E2; three-fold eight-prefix TEP/NPP/FCC coverage-efficiency validation over three grouped seeds
algorithms.closure_gate: full paper/capsule, exact empty-set postprocessing, synthetic dataset, and reference scores

algorithms.closure_gate: full modified-TF-IDF/KPCA equations, VAM simulator alarm data, hyperparameters, and reference scores

algorithms.closure_gate: full CTFH equations/parameters, publisher tables, and a reference-score run on the acquired TEP five-class alarm data

algorithms.closure_gate: full histogram/Transformer equations, exact hyperparameters, adapter for the acquired TEP alarm payload, and selected-paper reference scores
